objective: Let a reviewer ask one bounded what-if about a recorded run without editing it: apply a named in-memory transformation, recompute canonical state, report the difference.
decision_supported: Can a reviewer test a hypothetical input without mutating the bundle? Not before this; the only way to change the stream was to edit the run.
acceptance: One named transformation is applied per invocation.
The run bundle is never modified.
The report labels itself a counterfactual and states observed_run false.
A transformation that makes the stream invalid is reported, not raised.
stop_conditions: The change would grant release or physical-validation authority.
risks_and_fallbacks: A counterfactual could be mistaken for an observed run; the payload states observed_run false for that reason.
